dsh-llm-ollama 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Ollama Cloud 原生聊天适配器：直连 NDJSON 翻译 Ollama /api/chat 协议，模型发现带上下文窗口与能力信息，并注册 web 搜索/抓取 provider，附 Web 设置卡片。

posts.en:
dsh-llm-ollama is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Ollama Cloud native chat adapter: direct NDJSON translation of the Ollama /api/chat wire format, model discovery with context windows and capabilities, and web search/fetch providers under the ollama-cloud id, plus a Web settings card.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-10747891d809f8d5afee.html
